name: GlassSurface-TS-TW
title: GlassSurface
description: A wall of eight photos fills the stage under huge white words. A frosted glass rectangle can be dragged around, magnifying and warping the pictures beneath it with faint colour fringes.
use: A card or panel should sit over imagery with a frosted, refracting finish instead of a flat fill.
avoid: Safari and Firefox skip the refraction filter, so those browsers get only a plain blur.
a11y: The pane has focus styling but no tab stop, so it cannot be moved without a mouse, and it has no reduced-motion handling. (keyboard: no, labels: none, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Eight photos sit in two rows on a dark stage with giant white words across the middle. A rounded rectangular glass pane, lightly frosted, holds two lines of white text and shows a bent, colour-edged copy of whatever sits behind it.
behaves: Pressing and dragging the pane moves it over the photo wall, where the image inside shifts and magnifies with a slight rainbow edge. Releasing leaves it resting wherever it was dropped.
customise: Width, height, radius, border width, brightness, opacity, blur, displacement, background tint, saturation, distortion strength and blend mode are props.
weight: moderate: Per-channel SVG displacement plus backdrop filters on a small pane; still when not dragged.
